name: mcap-dexhand-quadtile
description: MCAP dexterous-hand rig, all cameras composited into /quad_tile/compressed
_comment: FREQUENTLY TUNED: the video block below; an explicit CLI flag always wins.
The dexhand counterpart of mcap-gripper-quadtile: same hero3 mosaic layout, but
20-DoF hands instead of grippers, so state_dim is 54 rather than 16. Use
mcap-dexhand when the rig publishes one topic per camera.
notes: Both hands publish joint_states in this generation, so end-effector observations
are measured rather than command echoes -- confirm via audit.end_effector_state_source
rather than assuming it, since the topic can still be empty in a given batch.
The mosaic is JPEG here, unlike express_raw's ~5 MB raw frames, so the recorder
is not blocked and the default state tolerance (1.5 joint_states periods) holds.
If a batch starts rejecting rows on arm_state, measure the staleness before
widening it -- see the notes in mcap-gripper-quadtile-raw for how.
